system.description:
Casting this incantation allows you to change the weather in an area up to 1 mile across. You may alter the direction of the wind, create or banish cloud cover, or cause light fog or rainfall.

The change occurs gradually over 10 minutes (1 dungeon action) and persists for 1 hour after that. Each spark increases the strength of the weather you conjure or doubles the duration. With seven sparks, you conjure a mighty blizzard or thunderstorm, and it persists for 1 week.
